title: Spacing, radius and shadows
intro: A 4 px base, generous rounded corners and soft navy-tinted shadows.

scale.title: Spacing scale
scale.description: Multiples of 4 px, the same units as Tailwind (p-4 = 16 px).

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: Controls have smaller corners than cards; fields and buttons use a soft pill shape.

elevation.title: Elevation
elevation.description: Two shadows: rest and hover. In dark mode they get denser to remain visible.

breakpoints.title: Breakpoints
breakpoints.description: Mobile-first: unprefixed styles apply to phones.
